classification.difficultyReason: Form and solve familiar angle-sum equations from four supplied quadrilaterals, including exterior and equal-angle information.

content.prompt: For each diagram below, write down an equation involving the pronumerals and then solve the equation.

spec.description: Quadrilateral ABCD with all four interior angles labelled; ordinary source blue outlines are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles at A, B, C and D are respectively 50°, 115°, γ and 60°.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; γ remains unknown.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}50^\circ+115^\circ+\gamma+60^\circ&=360^\circ\\225^\circ+\gamma&=360^\circ\\\gamma&=135^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle ABC with horizontal AC and B above A; ordinary outlines and labels black.
spec.mathematics: Angles A and B are α; angle C is 30°.
spec.answerVisibility: Both α labels and supplied 30° visible.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+\alpha+30^\circ&=180^\circ\\2\alpha&=150^\circ\\\alpha&=75^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral ABCD, A left and CD vertical; ordinary marks black.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles A=60°, B=2α, C=100°, D=α.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied labels visible; no solved angle added.

answer.short:
$\alpha=66\frac{2}{3}^\circ$.

Use the quadrilateral angle sum to obtain $3\alpha=200^\circ$.
answer.worked:
The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}60^\circ+2\alpha+100^\circ+\alpha&=360^\circ\\3\alpha+160^\circ&=360^\circ\\3\alpha&=200^\circ\\\alpha&=\frac{200}{3}^\circ=66\frac{2}{3}^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Quadrilateral PQRS with horizontal PQ and SRT, vertical QR and a right-angle square at Q; black marks.
spec.mathematics: P=110°, Q=90°, S=70°; α is exterior angle QRT.

answer.worked:
The interior angle at $R$ is $180^\circ-\alpha$ because $SRT$ is a straight line. Using the quadrilateral angle sum:
$$\begin{align*}110^\circ+90^\circ+70^\circ+(180^\circ-\alpha)&=360^\circ\\450^\circ-\alpha&=360^\circ\\-\alpha&=-90^\circ\\\alpha&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
